key_insight: MV-PVMapper maps individual rooftop photovoltaic modules with near-complete recovery by combining training-free segmentation with multi-view UAV photogrammetry.
engineering_relevance: Accurate module-level maps can support PV asset inventories and inspection workflows without task-specific image annotation or segmentation-model weight updates.
method: Generate candidate masks from UAV images using text-prompted SAM 3.
Project contours into object space with per-module slope correction and verify against representative module dimensions.
Feed accepted instances back to all covering views as box prompts for iterative segmentation, verification and fusion.
evidence_signal: Across three rooftop PV plants surveyed from five directions at approximately 1 cm nadir ground sampling distance, two feedback iterations recovered 7,710 of 7,711 reference modules with no false positives at IoU 0.5 and achieved a site-averaged aggregated Jaccard index of 97.55%.
watch_item: Performance beyond these three high-resolution rooftop surveys remains unproven, and implementation depends on reliable photogrammetry and representative module dimensions.
paper_title: High-fidelity training-free photovoltaic module mapping from multi-view UAV imagery
